rationale.N: native capture plus structural package observations provide some method diversity but remain one Hancom lineage.
rationale.I: left/right boundary, merged-span and width behavior support a bounded count=1 semantic rule; invalid count>1 evidence is excluded.
rationale.T: the rule survives multiple table structures including merged boundaries, but no cross-version transport is shown.
rationale.D: one misleading count>1 case is explicitly excluded and multiple structural edge cases are exercised.

literature_N_lane.Javadi et al. (2019): MID — fMRI and MEG are distinct modalities, but share task/hypothesis lineage; method-count alone cannot yield HIGH.
